thread:
Priya: Morning — quick sync. We need a short playbook for the Snowflake+Databricks connector backfill and integrated ingest auth for the vector DBs. Goal: coordinated marketplace listing + SI field enablement next week. Who can own runbook + gating checklist?
Evan: I can own the runbook draft. Will start from the existing connector preflight and add auth/backfill steps.
Marcos: Awesome. I'll handle partner comms and coordinate with Snow/DBX PMs. Need a clear list of API keys & entitlement checks we expect them to expose.
Priya: Thanks. Key asks: 1) backfill idempotency guarantees 2) rate-limit guidance for tenant-onboarding 3) a rollback plan if the backfill affects downstream vector indexes.
Jing: Security sign-off needed on any auto-ingest service principal. We need KMS policies and a short threat model. I'll add an audit checklist item: ensure no wide-role service accounts.
Sara: From product: we need to surface a toggle in Console for partner-initiated backfills and a telemetry flag so we can detect regressions in retrieval quality post-backfill. Minimal UX.
Rohit: Field note — SIs will expect a dry-run mode they can run in customer staging. Can we add a single-command invocation for dry-run + sample payload?
Evan: Yes. Drafting a CLI snippet now.
Evan: ```bash
# dry-run backfill against staging, no writes to vector DB
redwood ctl connector backfill --connector snowbridge --tenant t123 --dry-run --sample 200
```
Marcos: Perfect. I'll include that in the SI playbook. Also: what's the target SLA for backfill throughput? We should recommend conservative defaults to avoid overrunning Snow/DBX credits.
Priya: Recommend: default concurrency 4, max 16, adaptive retry on 429 with exponential backoff. Add an ops paragraph about monitoring Snow query credits and Databricks job runtimes.
Nadia: Support will need canned troubleshooting steps: common failure patterns (permission denied, rate-limited, schema drift). If people report duplicates in embeddings, what's the first triage?
Jing: First triage: check backfill idempotency token, then validate KV cache invalidation timing. Add a quick query they can run: `SELECT count(*) FROM connector_backfill_status WHERE tenant='t123' AND status='failed'`
Priya: Good. Also legal asked for data residency note — make sure the playbook explicitly lists which operations touch customer data and whether those are region-bound. Marcos, can you confirm partner listing text?
Marcos: Will update marketplace blurb: "Connector supports regionalized ingestion; backfills execute in partner region unless configured otherwise." Sending draft for review in #marketplace in 30m.
Evan: One more infra detail: we'll expose a metric `connector.backfill.progress{connector,tenant}` and `connector.backfill.errors`. Ops can create an alert if progress stalls > 2 hours.
integrations-bot: scheduled job connector-backfill-dryrun for tenant t123 started by Evan at 3161616180
Rohit: Can we add a short rollback command? Something reversible that's safe for vectors.
Evan: ```bash
# roll back last backfill batch (best-effort)
redwood ctl connector backfill --connector snowbridge --tenant t123 --rollback --batch 42
```
Sara: Add UX confirmation modal for rollback and a second approval for production rollbacks (must be from partner lead or security).
Priya: Ok owners: Evan = runbook + CLI examples, Marcos = partner marketplace text + partner comms, Jing = security checklist, Sara = Console toggle + telemetry spec, Rohit = SI dry-run ops, Nadia = support playbook. I'll assemble the playbook doc and ping each owner for a short blurb by EOD.
Marcos: I'll also schedule a 30-min dry-run demo with a top SI on Thursday.
Jing: Quick question — do we require HSM for customer-managed keys during backfill? If yes, note in the legal/residency section.
Priya: For now mark as optional; HSM recommended for regulated customers. We'll escalate if partner requires mandatory.
Nadia: Leaving a checklist item to confirm rollback testing in staging before marketplace listing.
Priya: Thanks all :white_check_mark: I'll post the initial playbook link here once Evan's draft is up.
integrations-bot: playbook doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/integrated-ingest-playbook (permissions: partnerships,eng,security)
Evan: Draft uploaded and shared with reviewers. tagging @Jing @Sara @Marcos for quick pass.
Marcos: Got it, will review in 30.
Rohit: I'm on the SI invite list. Will prep sample dataset and run the dry-run commands.
Priya: Great. If no blockers, we'll aim to include this playbook in the marketplace preflight bundle for the connector listing next Monday. Final call: any unresolved risks?
Jing: Risk: automatic backfills could expose large query patterns to partner infra. Mitigation: default to partner-managed execution with explicit opt-in for Redwood-run backfills. Add that line.
Priya: Noted. Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — please comment on the doc for any line edits. :rocket:
